name: Esteban Ribovics
summary: A high-volume Argentine kickboxer with power in hands and shins and a granite chin; all-action, bonus-magnet fights. Two of his three UFC losses came through takedowns.

how_they_fight.Striking: About 6.1 significant strikes a minute. Builds combinations well, uses kicks to finish combinations and to set up punches; off-beat timing (chop a kick, then punches) is his natural rhythm. Knocked out Edson Barboza in August.
how_they_fight.Grappling: The weak side: submitted by Mateusz Gamrot in April; takedowns decided two of his three UFC losses.
how_they_fight.Defense: Absorbs a lot (about 5.3 a minute) and trusts his chin to walk through it.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Keeps up a torrid pace for three rounds.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Wants a firefight; less comfortable when an opponent refuses to engage on his terms.

concerns: Hittable: aggression runs him onto counters
keys_to_beat: Wrestle him, especially off caught kicks
Counter up the middle as he comes in
